rememberObjects.title: Remember the Objects
rememberObjects.description: Memorize a group of items for a few seconds and pick them out from a larger collection.
rememberObjects.instruction: You will see {targetCount} objects for {seconds} seconds. Try to remember them all!

sequenceRecall.title: Sequence Recall
sequenceRecall.description: Watch the colorful lights flash in a rhythm and tap the exact same pattern.
sequenceRecall.instruction: Watch the colored tiles light up in order, then tap the tiles in the exact same sequence ({length} steps).

findPair.title: Find the Pair
findPair.description: Flip over hidden cards and find matching pairs of familiar shapes and symbols.
findPair.instruction: Tap cards to flip them over and match all {pairs} pairs of identical symbols!

whatChanged.title: What Changed?
whatChanged.description: Study a scene, watch closely when it hides, and spot which item changed.
whatChanged.instruction: Study the scene of {count} objects. We will briefly hide the screen and swap one item. Can you spot which one changed?
whatChanged.identifyHeader: 👉 Tap the item that CHANGED or is NEW!
whatChanged.successBanner: ✨ You found it! The {oldEmoji} {oldLabel} was replaced with {newEmoji} {newLabel}!
